	"fmt"
	"math"
	"math/big"

func integerArithmetic(multiply, wrap bool, left, right expression) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		a, err := present(left, context, at+"/left")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		x, err := integer(a, at)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		b, err := present(right, context, at+"/right")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		y, err := integer(b, at)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		exact := new(big.Int)
		result := x + y
		if multiply {
			exact.Mul(big.NewInt(x), big.NewInt(y))
			result = x * y
		} else {
			exact.Add(big.NewInt(x), big.NewInt(y))
		}
		if !wrap && !exact.IsInt64() {
			return nil, refusal(at, "integer_overflow", "arithmetic result exceeds signed 64-bit representation")
		}
		return result, nil
	}
}

type numericStep struct {
	op    string
	value float64
}

func floatBits(bits uint64) float64 { return math.Float64frombits(bits) }

func binary64Integer(value expression, steps []numericStep) expression {
	return func(context scope, at string) (any, error) {
		input, err := present(value, context, at+"/value")
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		var result float64
		switch input := input.(type) {
		case int64:
			result = float64(input)
		case uint64:
			result = float64(input)
		case float64:
			result = input
		default:
			return nil, refusal(at+"/value", "binary64_value", "expected a finite numeric value")
		}
		if math.IsNaN(result) || math.IsInf(result, 0) {
			return nil, refusal(at+"/value", "binary64_value", "expected a finite numeric value")
		}
		for index, step := range steps {
			switch step.op {
			case "multiply":
				result = float64(result * step.value)
			case "minimum":
				result = math.Min(result, step.value)
			case "maximum":
				result = math.Max(result, step.value)
			default:
				return nil, refusal(at, "target_operation", "unrecognized compiled numeric operation")
			}
			if math.IsNaN(result) || math.IsInf(result, 0) {
				return nil, refusal(fmt.Sprintf("%s/steps/%d", at, index), "binary64_overflow", "binary64 intermediate result is not finite")
			}
		}
		if result < -9223372036854775808.0 || result >= 9223372036854775808.0 {
			return nil, refusal(at, "binary64_range", "truncated binary64 value is outside signed 64-bit representation")
		}
		return int64(result), nil
	}
}
